resources.string: Are you sure you want to delete this event?

● 2/4/6/8: Select items on the screen
● ENTER: Press buttons, activate items, etc
● 1: Zoom Out
● 3: Zoom In
● ✱ SYM: Previous Page
● # ^aA^: Next Page
● ⌫: Delete items or text

● D-Pad Up/Down/Left/Right: Select items on the screen
● Start (Bottom-Left): Press buttons, activate items, etc
● X: Zoom Out
● Y: Zoom In
● A: Previous Page
● B: Next Page
● On the events list, press Left to delete an event.

● Up/Down/Left/Right: Select items on the screen
● Center: Press buttons, activate items, etc
● Top-Left: Zoom Out
● Top-Right: Zoom In
● Bottom-Left: Previous Page
● Bottom-Right: Next Page
● On the events list, press Left to delete an event.

● D-Pad Up/Down/Left/Right or 2/4/6/8: Select items on the screen
● D-Pad Center or 5: Press buttons, activate items, etc
● 1: Zoom Out
● 3: Zoom In
● ✱: Previous Page
● #: Next Page
● ⌫: Delete items or text
Press Left to delete an event.
